summary: Subhadradis Diskul (1923–2003) was a history and archaeology scholar who studied at Chulalongkorn University, École du Louvre under Philippe Stern, and UCL/University of London. He was curator at Bangkok National Museum, professor and rector at Silpakorn University, and SPAFA director.

Subhash Kak (born 1947) works in Indology and engineering. He studied at NIT Srinagar and IIT Delhi under Pavaguda V. Indiresan, later serving as professor at Louisiana State University and Regents Professor at Oklahoma State University.

Subrata K. Mitra (born 1949) is a scholar in history, archaeology, and other fields who studied at Utkal University, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Rochester. His career included posts at the University of Hull, Heidelberg University, and NUS.

Sucheng Chan (born 1941) is an American historian. She studied at Swarthmore College, the University of Hawaiʻi, and the University of California, Berkeley, and served as an emerita professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara from circa 1988 to 2005.
Sudan Shakya is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology who served as a professor at Shuchiin University (attested 2013–2017 and 2026).

Sudhakara Dvivedi (1855–1910) was an Indologist who studied under Devakṛṣṇa. He served as librarian and later professor and head of mathematics and astrology at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and Sanskrit College and University.

Sudhir Kakar (1938–2024) worked in religious studies and related fields. He studied at Gujarat University, Mannheim, Vienna, and the Sigmund-Freud-Institut, later holding posts at Harvard, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Delhi, and visiting appointments at INSEAD and other institutions.

Sue Hamilton is a scholar of Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Indology. She earned her D.Phil at the University of Oxford under Richard Gombrich and Alexis Sanderson, and held a post at King's College London (attested 2001–2003).

Suk Fun Ng is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a PhD at the University of Hong Kong (attested 2014) under doctoral supervisors Jing Yin and Yakupitiyage Karunadasa, having also studied under K. L. Dhammajoti.

Sukhlal Sanghvi (1880–1978) was an Indology and philosophy scholar who studied at Shri Yashovijaya Jain Sanskrit Pathshala and under Balakrishna Mishra. He served as professor of Indian philosophy at Gujarat Vidyapith and held the Chair of Jain Philosophy at BHU.

Sukumar Sen (1900–1992) was an Indian linguist and Indologist. He studied at Sanskrit College and the University of Calcutta under Suniti Kumar Chatterji and Irach Jehangir Sorabji Taraporewala, later serving at Calcutta as lecturer and Khaira Professor.

Sukumari Bhattacharji (1921–2014) was an Indologist and religious studies scholar. She studied at the University of Calcutta and Jadavpur University, later teaching at Lady Brabourne College and Jadavpur University.
Sulagna Bhattacharya is an Indologist who studied under doctoral supervisor Pratap Bandyopadhyay and holds an H P Shastri Research Fellowship at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).

Sulak Sivaraksa (born 1933) is a scholar and activist in Buddhist studies, philosophy, and religious studies. Educated at Assumption College and the University of Wales, Lampeter, he has held visiting posts at Lampeter, UC Berkeley, and Harvard.

Sumanapala Galmangoda is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He has served as Senior Professor and Director at the Postgraduate Institute of Pali and Buddhist Studies at the University of Kelaniya (attested 2007, 2012).

Sumathi Ramaswamy (born 1961) is an Indologist and historian who studied at the University of Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and the University of Pennsylvania. She held academic posts at the University of Pennsylvania and the University of Michigan.
Sumi Lee is a Buddhist studies and philosophy scholar. She completed an MA at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign under Alexander Leonhard Mayer and a PhD at UCLA under Robert E. Buswell Jr.

Sumitra Mangesh Katre (1906–1998) was an Indologist and linguist who received his Ph.D. from the University of London. He founded and held the Chair of Indo-European Philology at Deccan College and later taught at UT Austin.

Sun-Ah Choi is a scholar of Buddhist studies and history/archaeology. She completed her PhD at the University of Chicago under doctoral supervisor Juhyung Rhi, also studying under Richard Neer, Robert S. Nelson, Jaś Elsner, and Aden Kumler.
Sunanda Mukhopadhyay is an Indologist and linguist who conducted doctoral studies under Shyam Sundar Bhattacharya and is a research scholar at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).
